item.text: {"summary":"The failures point to positional `*` width and precision arguments being resolved with the wrong indexing state or argument ID. The supplied excerpts do not show the parser and lookup logic needed to identify a concrete repair.","hypotheses":["Positional width and precision parsing selects the wrong argument IDs, causing values to come from the wrong arguments or fail integer conversion.","A zero positional index after `*` is treated as an automatic argument reference before missing-argument validation, producing the wrong diagnostic.","The argument lookup path used for larger argument packs may differ from the path used for small packs and mishandle these positional references."],"queries":["parse_header","printf_precision_handler","parse_printf","basic_format_args::get"],"reads":[{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":334,"symbol":"parse_header"},{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":0,"symbol":"printf_handler"},{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":0,"symbol":"get_arg"},{"path":"include/fmt/format.h","line":0,"symbol":"basic_format_args"}],"ready":false}
